runMethylTFRFromRnBeads

Source: R/rnbeads_interface.R
runMethylTFRFromRnBeads.Rd

Run the methylTFR workflow directly on a preprocessed RnBeads object, without exporting per-sample BED files first.

Usage

runMethylTFRFromRnBeads(
  rnb_set,
  tf_bindsites = NULL,
  gcfreqs = NULL,
  gc_dist = NULL,
  chunkSize = 20,
  threads = 1,
  enhancer = NULL,
  ignoreStrand = TRUE,
  cov_threshold = 1,
  dpval_threshold = 0.05,
  sample_ann = NULL,
  tempDir = file.path(tempdir(), "methylTFR")
)

Arguments

rnb_set

A preprocessed RnBSet object, for example loaded with RnBeads::load.rnb.set().

tf_bindsites

A GRangesList named by motif. Each element is a GRanges of the occurrences of that motif. The names must include every name in names(gcfreqs). Get it with getTFbindsites(motifSet = "jaspar2020") from the methylTFRAnnotationHg38 (or methylTFRAnnotationMm10) package, or build a custom set with methylTFRAnnotationBuilder.

gcfreqs

A named list with one element per motif, named as in tf_bindsites. Each element is a numeric matrix with the five GC bins in rows and the positions across the binding-site window in columns. Get it with getGCfreq(motifSet = ...) from the annotation package.

gc_dist

A GRanges object of 30-bp genomic windows with an integer metadata column GC_bin (1 to 5). Get it with getGenomeGC() from the annotation package.

chunkSize

Number of motifs processed together in one block. Default 20.

threads

Number of workers used to process the motifs of a chunk in parallel. Default 1 (serial).

enhancer

An optional GRanges object of regions, for example distal regulatory elements. Binding sites outside these regions are dropped. Any region set imported as GRanges works, for example the ENCODE candidate cis-regulatory elements (SCREEN) read with rtracklayer::import(). Default NULL uses all binding sites.

ignoreStrand

Logical. If TRUE (default), strand is ignored when overlapping methylation sites with annotations.

cov_threshold

Numeric, minimum coverage of a retained site. Used only for sequencing sets. Default 1.

dpval_threshold

Numeric, maximum detection p-value of a retained probe. Used only for array sets. Default 0.05.

sample_ann

Optional data.frame with one row per sample, in the same order as the samples in rnb_set. All columns are kept as colData of the result; no column is required. Default NULL uses RnBeads::pheno(rnb_set).

tempDir

Directory for the temporary HDF5 files written during a run. Default is a folder under tempdir(). The files are deleted when the run finishes.

Value

A methylTFRdeviations object with the assays deviations, z and expected, motifs in rows and samples in columns.

Details

Methylation calls are read at single-cytosine resolution. Sequencing sets (RnBiseqSet) are filtered by coverage, array sets (RnBeadSet) by detection p-value. The number of sites retained per sample is reported through logger.

See also

runMethylTFR for running methylTFR from per-sample BED files.

Examples

# A minimal end-to-end run on the BATF example data bundled with the
# package. The bundled calls are wrapped in an RnBiseqSet so that the
# example exercises the same code path as a preprocessed RnBeads object.
load(system.file("extdata", "example_data.rda", package = "methylTFR"))
load(system.file("extdata", "BATF_tf_bindsites.rda", package = "methylTFR"))
load(system.file("extdata", "BATF_gcfreqs.rda", package = "methylTFR"))
load(system.file("extdata", "gcdist_subset.rda", package = "methylTFR"))

if (requireNamespace("RnBeads", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("RnBeads.hg38", quietly = TRUE)) {
    # identifiers.column is a session option, not a property of the object,
    # so it has to be set before the set is built or samples() falls back
    # to row numbers and methylTFR cannot name the columns it returns
    old_ids <- RnBeads::rnb.getOption("identifiers.column")
    RnBeads::rnb.options(identifiers.column = "sampleName")

    sites <- data.frame(
        chr = as.character(GenomicRanges::seqnames(msites)),
        start = GenomicRanges::start(msites),
        strand = "*",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    rnb_set <- RnBeads::RnBiseqSet(
        pheno = data.frame(sampleName = "sample_1"),
        sites = sites,
        meth = matrix(msites$score, ncol = 1,
                      dimnames = list(NULL, "sample_1")),
        covg = matrix(msites$coverage, ncol = 1,
                      dimnames = list(NULL, "sample_1")),
        assembly = "hg38",
        summarize.regions = FALSE
    )

    devs <- runMethylTFRFromRnBeads(
        rnb_set = rnb_set,
        tf_bindsites = tf_bindsites,
        gcfreqs = gcfreqs,
        gc_dist = gcdist
    )
    RnBeads::rnb.options(identifiers.column = old_ids)
    deviations(devs)
}
